title: Require Map Config Catalog File Shape
forbids: map config catalogs with repository-path membership, alternate export authorities, or admission that bypasses canonical id-derived filename validation
why: A map product catalog owns ordered identities, not storage paths. One closed membership and admission shape keeps config identity stable while generators remain free to derive local storage paths.
remediate: Export MAP_CONFIG_CATALOG_IDS plus admitMapConfigCatalogIds from membership.ts, derive the canonical filename from configId in admission.ts, delegate envelope validation to the canonical config owner, and re-export only those authorities from index.ts.
message: Map config catalog files must preserve the positive identity-membership and canonical-admission shape.
